what.text: This page follows refugees from Yemen in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 57327 refugees from Yemen.
Somalia hosts the largest share, 23.5%, followed by the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Yemen in every year from 2008 to 2025, at war level in most of them, with Ansarallah, AQAP and the Alliance of Yemeni Tribes among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over South Yemen territory in 1994 and with the STC in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1990 at 5 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country; people displaced inside Yemen are counted separately.
